summary: Tsutomu Kubo was a philosophy scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo from around 1904 to 1907. He later held a post at Tohoku University from circa 1926 to 1944.

Tsuyoshi Yokoyama works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He completed doctoral studies at Kyoto University (attested 2015-2017) and held an appointed researcher post at the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies, attested in 2017.

Tu Weiming is a scholar of philosophy, Sinology, and religious studies who studied at Tunghai University and Harvard University. He held faculty posts at Princeton, UC Berkeley, Harvard (1981-2010), the Harvard-Yenching Institute (1996-2008), and Peking University (~2010).
Tukaram Krishna Laddu was an Indologist and linguist who completed studies at the University of Halle-Wittenberg in 1912. He later held a post at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, attested in 1920.

Tulku Sherdor is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. He studied at Vassar College, Naropa University, and the University of Virginia, and trained under Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Ted Norton, and Jeffrey Hopkins.
Tulku Thondup worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Dodrupchen Monastery under Kyala Khenpo and Khenpo Chemchok, and later served as a visiting scholar at Harvard University.

Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure who studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Dzongsar Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje. He taught numerous students, including Chokyi Nyima Rinpoche and Tsoknyi Rinpoche.

Turrell V. Wylie was a Tibetologist who studied at the University of Washington and under Giuseppe Tucci. He spent his career at the University of Washington, holding posts in 1953, 1959, and becoming a professor in 1970.

Tyler Dewar is a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at the Nitartha Institute (attested 2008, 2019) and trained under Acharya Tashi Wangchuk (2003-2004) and Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche (attested 2019).

Tzungkuen Wen is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD at the University of Queensland under Primož Pecenko, Tamara Ditrich, and Chris Kang. He also studied under Yangzhu Xu, Nandasiri Sayadaw, and U Pandita, and lectured at Fuyan Buddhist Institute.

Tōru Funayama is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. He studied at Kyoto University and under Ernst Steinkellner, later holding posts at Kyushu University (attested 1999-2003) and Kyoto University (attested 1995-2019).
U Dhammissara is a Buddhist studies scholar who pursued a Master of Arts under the supervision of Sanu Mahatthanadull at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University, attested in 2017.
Ugyen Pelgen is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Tibetology. He earned a master's degree from Aligarh Muslim University and served as a lecturer of history at Sherubtse College.

Ulrich Pagel works in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology. He studied under Tadeusz Skorupski, Philip Denwood, and Renate Söhnen-Thieme, and held a post at SOAS University of London attested from 2013 to 2020.

Ulrich Timme Kragh specializes in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology. After studying at the University of Copenhagen and Karmapa International Buddhist Institute, he held positions at Copenhagen, Harvard, Geumgang University, IIAS, the University of Sydney, and Australian National University.

Ulrike Roesler specializes in Tibetology and Indology, having earned her PhD at the University of Münster. She taught Indian and Tibetan studies at the universities of Marburg and Freiburg before becoming Professor of Tibetan and Himalayan Studies at Oxford.

Uma Chakravarti is a scholar of history, archaeology, Buddhist studies, and Indology. She studied at Miranda House (~1958-1962) and the University of Delhi (~1975-1985), completing her doctoral studies under D. Devahuti.

Unnikrishnan Payyappallimana studied at Ayurveda College, Coimbatore, and the University of Amsterdam. He held posts at the FRLHT (1995), Amala Institute of Medical Sciences, and the University of Toyama (1998; 2003-2004).

Unrai Wogihara was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at the University of Strasbourg under Ernst Leumann, as well as under Junjirō Takakusu. He held posts at the University of Tokyo and Taisho University (~1926-1937).

Uranchimeg B. Ujeed is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies who earned a Ph.D. from SOAS University of London. She served as a research associate in the Mongolia and Inner Asia Unit at the University of Cambridge.
